Product lead time: time that applies to a given item whoever orders it, such as packing, quality checks, kitting or vendor lead time for items you don't stock.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: UTGST Tax support in Commerce [India Tax Localization]
items.desc:
This feature adds UTGST (Union Territory Goods and Services Tax) to the Commerce channel - store Commerce/POS/Trade POS and e‑commerce transactions in union territories.
What UTGST is: For union territories in India that don't have a legislature, the GST Council introduced UTGST, which is comparable to SGST. UTGST applies to the following union territories of India: Chandigarh Lakshadweep Daman and Diu Dadra and Nagar Haveli Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Delhi and Puducherry have their own legislatures, so they stay on SGST.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add references to your Copilot Notebooks from the Quick Access section in Search on the M365 Copilot app

items.title: Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
items.desc: Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. items.title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
items.desc: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

items.title: Access: Cascading combo and list boxes with LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields

items.title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
items.desc: GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
items.desc: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
items.desc: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Upgraded music selection for Copilot AI Videos
items.desc: With a Microsoft365 Copilot license, Copilot AI-generated video projects have improved audio with realistic AI voiceover, professional sound effects, and enhanced audio mixing.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
items.desc: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
items.desc: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Entra ID Backup & Recovery
items.desc: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. items.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.desc: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.

items.desc: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. preview, enabling customers to configure Azure Firewall and Firewall Policy in
dual-stack mode for both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic. This preview allows native IPv6
network-rule filtering and DNS Proxy support, helping organizations secure
cloud, hybrid, and internal IPv6 traffic as they modernize toward dual-stack
architectures.

safety and predictability for customers managing large or complex rule sets

certificate authentication, enables Azure Front Door to authenticate clients

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word
items.desc: Interact in real time with read aloud in Word with Copilot. While your document is being read aloud, you can ask questions with your voice—such as “What does this mean?” or “Summarize this section”—and get answers instantly. items.title: Public Preview: Perimeter link feature in network security perimeter
items.desc:
Perimeter link (cross-perimeter
connectivity) is a network security perimeter capability that allows trusted
resources in two different network security perimeters to securely communicate
with each other using Managed Identity (MSI), without requiring additional network
security perimeter access rules or network configuration changes. It preserves
Zero Trust boundaries while enabling controlled service-to-service access
across perimeters

more.

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Private Link support over IPv6

Azure Private Link over IPv6
enables you to privately access Azure PaaS services, such as Azure Storage and

endpoints to connect from IPv6 clients in an Azure virtual network or from
on-premises networks over ExpressRoute.

more.

items.title: Public Preview: Azure DNS enables DNS-based load balancing through Traffic Manager integration
